meta.title: Local planner
meta.description: Shared memos, lightweight tasks, a month calendar, and a persistent today summary inside DSH. No automatic AI execution.

title: Local planner
subtitle: A small workspace for notes, tasks, and your day.
sharedNote: Shared in this DSH host, across chats and AI tools. Projects are labels, not private spaces. Notes are not automatically sent to AI.
manualNote: Dates organize your work; they do not schedule or run AI automatically.
summaryEmpty: No tasks due today. Make room for what matters.
archiveHint: Archived items stay here until you restore them.
emptyHint: Create an item or adjust your filters.
emptyDayHint: Choose a date or add a task to start planning.
calendarPartial: Showing {loaded} of {total} tasks this month. Load more to see the rest.
calendarHelp: Choose a day to see its tasks. Each date is an all-day date.
titlePlaceholder: What would you like to remember or do?
contentPlaceholder: Details, context, or a small next step…
convertHint: Choose a date if needed, then save the conversion.
archiveDraftHint: Save or discard your edits before archiving or restoring.
draftKept: Your draft stays here while the list refreshes.
discardQuestion: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and continue?
reloadQuestion: Reloading replaces your unsaved draft with the latest saved item. Continue?
conflict: This item changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved. Copy any text you need, then reload the latest version before editing again.
externalChange: This item has a newer saved revision. Your draft has not been changed.
saveInterrupted: The previous request was interrupted. Its result is unknown; refresh and check saved items before retrying.
errorRequest: Could not complete the request. Please try again.
errorNetwork: Cannot reach the planner. Check the connection, then refresh.
errorInvalid: Some fields are invalid. Check the title, date, and field limits.
errorNotFound: This item no longer exists. Your draft is preserved.
errorStorage: The result is uncertain. Reload this plugin or restart DSH, then check the saved item before retrying. Do not repeatedly submit the same write.
errorDisposed: The planner is not active. Refresh the page or check the plugin.
errorTags: Use at most 12 tags, with no more than 40 characters per tag.
readOnlyArchive: Archived items can be restored. Restore this item before editing it.
editorHint: Select an item to edit it, or create a new memo or task.
